Thirty-odd brick hot-air balloons fill every height at once, the nearest a vast magenta-and-lime gore-striped mass cropped by the top and left edges, a bee-shaped one with black and egg-yolk smooth unmarked panels whole and readable in the middle distance, a cupcake-shaped balloon three lengths back, and a scatter of cobalt-and-white chequerboard specks bright and small near the top of the frame.

Forty or more hot-air balloons fan out across the full width of the sky at wildly different heights, the nearest a tangerine crown-to-skirt gradient in stepped brick rows so large its basket rim nearly fills the lower edge, a teapot-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a curved-slope spout in the middle distance, and the farthest as small as a single minifigure, every gore-seam and macaroni-brick edge vivid against cobalt.

A staggered launch of thirty-two hot-air balloons, the first dozen already high and small while twenty more swell on the grass as long slack coloured sleeves, a cyan-and-white chequerboard already taut and lifting, a dragon-head balloon with its snout still drooping and one smooth-panelled side flat against the tuft elements, the whole field leaning one way in a crosswind while six stand fully upright blazing vermilion and lime.

Fifteen of thirty hot-air balloons lie flat on the grass as long coloured sleeves, vermilion, hot-pink, cobalt and egg-yolk, the smooth unmarked panels pooled in soft heaps across the green plate mosaic, while the other fifteen stand fully round and taut behind them, the nearest a hot-dog-shaped balloon with a curved-slope bun already enormous, a spiral of lime and white winding to its crown three balloons back.

At dawn, thirty hot-air balloons launch shin-deep in trans-white mist plates, the nearest a huge cobalt-and-vermilion chevron mass with its basket bar-and-clip corners just above the mist surface, a mushroom-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a rounded cap in the middle distance, and two dozen more ascending at every height, the farthest already small and blazing with tangerine and hot-pink against a pale apricot sky.

At dusk, two dozen hot-air balloons glow lantern-lit from inside by their burners, each trans-orange flame element casting a different saturated hue outward through the smooth unmarked brick panels, the nearest a vast hot-pink-and-white spiral filling the left side of the frame, a rocket-shaped balloon three baskets back, and the highest small warm dots of lime and egg-yolk against a deepening cobalt sky.

A wind has fanned forty-odd hot-air balloons across the full width of the sky at every height, the nearest a cathedral-sized magenta-and-cobalt chequerboard with its load tapes pulled taut at an angle, a penguin-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a white-front curved slope belly whole and readable in the middle ground, and the farthest specks drifting high toward the right edge of the frame, every panel unmarked brick.

The fleet drifts low enough that the nearest baskets skim the treeline, thirty hot-air balloons at all heights from just above the moulded plant elements to tiny specks near the top of the frame, the closest a lime-and-tangerine gore-striped mass so near its basket rim and chrome burner cylinder fill the lower third, a snail-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a coiled spiral shell hull just clearing the canopy behind it.

A crowded inflation field of two dozen part-swollen hot-air balloons lean against one another like a field of enormous fruit, vermilion, lime, cobalt, egg-yolk and hot-pink, smooth unmarked panels bunched and creasing, an owl-shaped balloon with two big dish-element eyes already fully round among them, six more taut and rising beyond, their gore seams sharp and their baskets swinging as the burners fire.

On a cold morning thirty hot-air balloons lie pale and slack across the green plate mosaic except six already taut and blazing, the nearest of the six a vast egg-yolk-and-cobalt spiral that fills the right half of the frame, a castle-turret-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with crenellated curved-slope battlements beside it, and two dozen limp coloured sleeves still spread across the tuft elements between the ground crew.

A competition launch sends thirty hot-air balloons up from all round the field at wildly different heights, the nearest a vermilion-and-white chequerboard so large it is cropped on three sides, a toucan-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a broad curved-slope beak climbing steeply off to the left, a cobalt-and-lime gore-striped one already far over to the right, and the rest scattered wide and small across the whole width of the upper frame.

A fleet where a third of the hot-air balloons are shaped and the rest are striped and chequered, thirty balloons at all heights, the nearest a fish-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with scaled curved-slope flanks and a broad tail fin cropped by the lower edge, a bee beside it already lifting, and beyond them hot-pink and tangerine gore-striped spheres and magenta-and-cobalt chequerboards at every depth to the horizon.

Thirty hot-air balloons rise at every height in a narrow alpine valley between brick-modelled pasture and white cloud-slope peaks, the nearest a cathedral-sized cobalt-and-vermilion chevron mass filling the lower left of the frame, a tiny single-seat lime-and-white spiral balloon barely as tall as the near basket's bar-and-clip rim beside it, the farthest balloons half-lost in the light near the mountain tops, panels smooth and unmarked.

A shaft of afternoon sun catches eight hot-air balloons so they blaze — magenta, tangerine, egg-yolk, lime — while twenty-odd more sit in cool shadow behind them, thirty in total at all heights, the nearest a blazing hot-pink-and-white chequerboard cropped by the top edge, a cupcake-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a domed frosting crown illuminated three back, and the shadowed ones dark saturated silhouettes beyond.

Thirty-odd hot-air balloons hang over a frozen lake so every balloon is repeated in the trans-blue plate ice below, thirty-odd at all heights from enormous nearest to bright specks at the top of the frame, the closest a tangerine-and-cobalt gore-striped mass whose reflection fills the lower third, a penguin-shaped smooth-panelled balloon whole and readable in the middle distance with its mirror perfect in the ice beneath.

Thirty hot-air balloons stand so tall in the frame that the nearest is cropped by the top, both sides and the lower edge at once, its magenta-and-lime gore-striped panels filling the corners, a dragon-head balloon with a vermilion curved-slope snout whole in the middle distance, and a scatter of egg-yolk and hot-pink chequerboard specks near the very top of the frame, every panel smooth unmarked brick.

Twenty-four hot-air balloons launch in mass ascension at every height simultaneously, the nearest a hot-pink-and-white spiral so vast the basket bar-and-clip uprights nearly scrape the lower frame edge, a rocket-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a pointed slope nose cone whole and readable one length back, and a dozen tiny tangerine and cobalt specks climbing high and small against deep blue, gore seams vivid as stud rows.

Forty-odd hot-air balloons spread at every height in a mass ascension at the moment the last ground ropes are loosed, the nearest a lime-and-vermilion chequerboard with a minifigure arm cropped by the frame still waving from the basket, a hot-dog-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a curved-slope bun rising beside it, and the farthest a scatter of magenta and egg-yolk specks high and small, panels unmarked brick.

A staggered launch of thirty-four hot-air balloons at dusk, twelve already high and glowing lantern-warm while twenty-two more still crouch on the grass half-swollen, the lowest six lantern-lit through smooth unmarked panels in cobalt, hot-pink and lime, a mushroom-shaped balloon with its cap just filling with air and tilting, the highest already small bright dots against a deep tangerine and violet sky, gore seams picked out by the burner glow.

Thirty hot-air balloons fan across a wide valley at wildly different heights, the nearest a vast egg-yolk-and-cobalt chevron mass cropped on the left and top, a snail-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a coiled curved-slope shell whole and readable in the middle ground, and beyond it a field of magenta, lime, hot-pink and vermilion gore-striped spheres and chequerboards climbing to bright specks near the frame top.

Twenty-four hot-air balloons glow against a cobalt night sky, each lantern-lit from inside by its trans-orange burner flame, the nearest a spiral of vermilion and white so bright it washes the near basket chrome cylinder in orange, a teapot-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with a curved-slope handle two lengths back, and the highest small warm halos of lime and magenta floating like embers, every panel smooth and unmarked.

Forty or more hot-air balloons crowd a dawn inflation field shin-deep in trans-white mist, the nearest a vast cobalt-and-hot-pink chequerboard with its crown just catching the first apricot light, a castle-turret-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with crenellated slopes rising taut beside it, twenty more slack and swelling behind them, and the farthest already clear of the mist and small against a pale lime-tinged sky, panels unmarked.

Thirty hot-air balloons hang over a frozen lake at dusk, the whole mass doubled in the trans-blue plate ice, the nearest a hot-pink-and-lime gore-striped balloon so large its basket nearly touches the frame lower edge and its reflection nearly touches it from below, a bee-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with black and egg-yolk bands whole in the middle, and a dozen warm-glowing lantern specks high and small above.

Thirty-odd hot-air balloons ascend in competition from all round the field, the nearest a vermilion-and-cobalt spiral cropped by three frame edges, a fish-shaped smooth-panelled balloon with curved-slope tail fins climbing steeply from the left, a tangerine chequerboard low behind the treeline on the right, and twenty more spread unevenly across the sky, none of them at the same height as another.

Twenty-four partly swollen hot-air balloons lean together like enormous fruit across the green plate mosaic, hot-pink, egg-yolk, lime and vermilion smooth unmarked panels bunching and dimpling, a penguin-shaped balloon with a white curved-slope belly already round and upright among them, and six fully taut behind — one a vast cobalt-and-white chequerboard, one a tangerine crown-to-skirt gradient in stepped brick rows — their burner flames white-orange and roaring.
